verdict.rationale: The firm's own Book of Jargon – Emerging Companies glossary includes founder-equity terms such as "83(b) Election", "Cliff Vesting" and "Vesting Schedule", and LathamDrive offers a document generator for incorporation documents. These are glossary definitions and formation tooling, though, not substantive guidance on setting up founder equity. missing for 10: in-depth guidance on structuring vesting schedules and filing 83(b) elections (or local equivalents), any coverage of co-founder equity splits, evidence that the document generator produces founder stock or vesting agreements, and independent corroboration.
